description: Implementation of the Climate-Resilient Sustainable Water Supply and Sanitation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-09-07 to conduct formal negotiations with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to secure a loan of USD 200 million under the ADB’s Regular Ordinary Capital Resources for the implementation of the Climate-Resilient Sustainable Water Supply and Sanitation Project. Negotiations for obtaining the said loan have been concluded as of now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development to sign the relevant Loan Agreements with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said loan, was approved by the Cabinet.
